title: Replace Incoming Connection on Input Connect
description: When connecting to an input channel in flow, replace the current incoming connection instead of rejecting the connection.
summary: Input channel connections now replace any existing incoming wire on the same port. GraphEngine gained allow_target_replace on is_valid_connection (enabled for wire draw/snap, disabled for node-drag proximity), and try_connect_handles removes the displaced incoming edge via remove_edge before creating the new one. FlowHost.connect_ports retains the same replace semantics for programmatic connects. Updated wire_snap test and added connect_ports_replaces_existing_incoming_on_same_input.
